Puzzle 9-39 Carmen's husband, Steven, died of a heart attack after they had been married for many years. One day, a few months later, she received a small package in the mail. She opened the package, pulled out the tiny stone inside, and said “Hello, Steven.” Why? Clues: 1. Steven had not sent her the stone. 2. Steven was still deceased. Puzzle 9-56 After a car accident, many people say that they wish they had left their house a few minutes earlier, or later, than they did. Laurie wished she had left five minutes later, but she was not involved in a car accident. How did she die? Clues: 1. Laurie was driving. 2. Laurie was running behind schedule.
